### When is the 2026 US Open?

The 2026 US Open runs from Aug 23 to Sept. 13, with the main draw beginning Sunday, Aug 30.

### Where will the 2026 US Open be played?

The 2026 US Open will be played at the Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, located in Flushing Meadows-Corona Park, Queens, New York.
